name: China CAMC Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: China CAMC Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in design consulting and engineering contracting business in China and internationally. It provides design consulting for hospitals and health centers, culture tourism and commerce, industry and scientific engineering, modern logistics, energy, environmental protection, and BIM; and project contracting for industrial projects, mining and underground engineering, power projects, water engineering projects, agriculture projects, communications, architecture and municipal administration, and environment.
